[SWS_PHM_01329]
{OBSOLETE}
Reporting of undefined Health Status Identifier
⌈
If a
healthStatusId
is reported to
Platform Health Management
and no cor-
responding
PhmHealthChannelStatus
is configured in the context of the reporting
PhmHealthChannelInterface
, PHM shall ignore the reporting of healthStatus.
⌋
(RS_PHM_00102, RS_PHM_09257)
